environments.name: 폭풍의 산문
environments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished 2D side-scrolling Unity defense-game battlefield background. Input image is a STYLE AND GAMEPLAY-LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY. Create a different environment, matching the reference's polished anime game background painting, crisp architecture, layered distant scenery, saturated cool night palette with controlled warm accents, and clear readable foreground. WIDE 16:9 landscape composition. The combat walkway must be straight, unobstructed, and horizontal across the ENTIRE width: its flat surface occupies 65% through 76% of image height measured from the top, with the characters' feet baseline at 73%. Keep that geometry nearly identical to the reference so existing side-view sprites stand naturally on it. No people, characters, creatures, vehicles, HUD, text, labels, logos or watermarks. Leave the middle of the walkway and the entire center battle space open. Put ornate architecture at the far left and right margins and deep scenery behind it; do not add obstacles on the floor. No huge effects covering combatants. Scene: a ruined mountaintop shrine pass in a distant violet thunderstorm, after the heroes have crossed the moon bridge. Cracked dark stone walkway with subtle wet reflections, worn red torii and amber lanterns on the far left, pale jade and blue spirit shrine pillars and a misty gate on the far right. Behind the clear battle lane: receding stone stairs, enormous ancient cedars, mountains swallowed by rolling violet clouds, a few thin distant lightning branches high in the sky, windswept autumn leaves at the edges. Rich purple-indigo, teal and warm amber, elegant dramatic depth. The platform is intact and usable, even though the distant buildings are weathered. Rain stays a delicate atmosphere in the distance, without strong foreground streaks. Original background artwork, no borrowed game UI.
